title: Find the top eigenvector with repeated products
brief: Read an eigenvalue with the Rayleigh quotient, find the top eigenvector by multiplying and rescaling, and deflate to expose the second one.
hints: rayleigh_quotient is one line: v @ A @ v / (v @ v).
power_iteration: start from np.ones(d) / np.sqrt(d), then loop `v = A @ v; v = v / np.linalg.norm(v)`. Rescale inside the loop, every step.
deflate: A - eigenvalue * np.outer(v, v). np.outer builds a (d, d) matrix; v @ v is only a number.
